caption: The video captures an outdoor tabletop scene where a wooden xylophone with eight colored metal bars lies diagonally against a sun-dappled concrete wall, ringed by scattered glossy marbles. At the right edge, angled tube chutes release marbles that roll along the back edge of the instrument, and this motion is already underway. A red marble leaves the tube mouth and travels steadily leftward along the rear rail, easing toward the middle bars. Behind it, a white marble emerges from the chute and drifts along the same back edge. A small magenta marble drifts leftward along the back rail, and a second magenta marble emerges near the tube mouth. The marbles resting on the colored bars hold their places with only minor jitter, whereas the loose marbles on the open table shift in slow rolling motion. The framing itself drifts, sliding the tubes partly toward the right edge. Throughout, marbles continue to rest and roll along the colorful bars.
